P100967.name: The Long Walker
P100967.tagline: One long walk (35–40 min) does most of the work
nuEnhancements: Add 5 more minutes to hit the 40-min sweet spot - Your Day 10 (40-min walk) had a flatter evening curve than Day 7 (35-min). The last 5 minutes buys measurable AGP smoothing — you're already close.

P100967.name: The Splitter
P100967.tagline: Two shorter walks spread through the day
nuEnhancements: Never skip the post-lunch stroll — it's 40% of the effect - Your Day 5 data: the 10-min post-lunch walk cut the lunch spike from +52 → +30 mg/dL. That short walk is doing outsized work. Protect it on your calendar.
Estimated lift: +3–5 TIR points on high-carb-lunch days

P100967.name: The Fiber-Forward
P100967.tagline: Complex carbs + fiber-forward meals; less activity needed
nuEnhancements: Layer in a 15-min post-lunch walk to hit the ceiling - Fiber-forward days already sit at avg 95% TIR without much walking. Adding just 15 min after lunch pushes you into 100% TIR territory, at very low effort cost.

P100967.name: The Protein-Anchored
P100967.tagline: High-protein breakfast + lunch keeps CV low
nuEnhancements: Swap oats + walnuts in on days you don't want eggs - Your Day 7 (Greek yogurt + walnuts) matched the CV of your egg days. Rotate to keep the protein anchor without eating the same breakfast every day.
Estimated lift: Same CV benefit, higher adherence

P100967.name: The Hydration Champion
P100967.tagline: Hitting the water goal + any 30-min walk
nuEnhancements: Front-load 4 glasses before noon — shrinks the dawn phenomenon further - Your morning glucose rise correlates with overnight hydration. Getting 4 glasses in by lunch (vs. spread through the day) trimmed your dawn rise on Day 10.
Estimated lift: Fasting glucose: –4–6 mg/dL further
